title: Immobilization
description: Information about biocatalyst immobilization on solid supports.

biocatalyst_state.title: biocatalyst_state
biocatalyst_state.description: Physical state of the biocatalyst during immobilization (e.g., purified enzyme, crude extract).

carrier_material.title: carrier_material
carrier_material.description: Material used as the solid support for immobilization.

immobilisation_chemistry.title: immobilisation_chemistry
immobilisation_chemistry.description: Chemical method or mechanism used for immobilization (e.g., covalent binding, adsorption, entrapment).

immobilisation_method.title: immobilisation_method
immobilisation_method.description: Detailed procedure used for the immobilization process.

immobilized.title: immobilized
immobilized.description: Whether the biocatalyst is immobilized (true) or used in free form (false).

linkers.title: linkers
linkers.description: Chemical linkers or spacers used between the enzyme and carrier material.

loading.title: loading
loading.description: Amount of enzyme loaded onto the carrier material.

notes.title: notes
notes.description: Additional notes about the immobilization process or properties.

purification_method.title: purification_method
purification_method.description: Method used to purify or wash the immobilized biocatalyst.

Concentration.title: Concentration
Concentration.description: Quantitative information about biocatalyst concentration in the reaction.

determination_method.title: determination_method
determination_method.description: Method used to determine or calculate the concentration.

unit.title: unit
unit.description: Unit of measurement for the concentration (e.g., mg/mL, µM, U/mL).
